title: Verified, never settled
situation: Your agent paid for an API call. The facilitator verified the payment authorization and the resource was delivered. Thirty minutes later the agent's operator asked whether the payment actually settled. Everything the agent recorded is below.

paymentTranscript.detail: Agent signed an exact-scheme authorization for 250000 atomic USDC (0.25 USDC) to the payTo in the challenge, validBefore 30 minutes after signing.
Resource returned HTTP 200 with the requested snapshot after the payment header was presented.
Searched Base blocks 61234000 to 61234520 (about 30 minutes) for a USDC Transfer from the agent wallet to the challenge payTo of 250000.

clientObservedOutcome: On the strength of the verify response alone, the agent marked the task complete and recorded the purchase as paid. It performed no settlement check before closing the task.
